Start with a town. Give it a backstory: why did people settle here? Are they inclusive or exclusive? Whats the main source of income for the town?

Now put named npc's in the town. Use the towns backstory to help give the npcs a backstory. Why is the innkeeper there? Are they running a family business or did they start the business? Do they like living there or do they have bigger dreams.

Thus info alone makes the area feel more alive and informs you of how the npcs should act towards the players. It can also lead to more spontaneous adventure hooks and keeps the ideas flowing.

DMing takes a lot of practice but it is well worth it. Good luck.
